messages:
josh_support: FYI — customer (AcmeCorp) hit a streaming JSON truncation again, but it only happens when traffic flows through their corporate proxy. They see a perfectly valid JSON object stream, then the socket closes mid-object.

josh_support: sample truncated chunk they pasted: `{"id":"msg_42","role":"assistant","content":"Here's the full answer but it cuts off mid-word: \"Infrastruc` <EOF>

eve_customer: reproducer from our side:
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-14b","stream":true,"input":"summarize..."}'
```
We sometimes get a final partial JSON object, no trailing newline. Happens ~1-3% of requests. We can't bypass proxy for production.

maria_eng: thanks — can you paste the x-request-id/trace-id from one of the failed requests and the exact timestamp? also the region and route?

josh_support: request-id: rx-9f3b2a, route: /v1/streams/generate, region: us-west-2, fail observed 2026-11-12T15:04:28Z. customer says proxy injects a TLS-terminating gateway and also does per-connection idle timeout of 20s.

maria_eng: initial hypothesis: proxy is closing the upstream connection while our runtime is still streaming the last chunk(s). When the proxy cuts, the client-facing connection goes down and the last partial chunk is lost; client sees truncated JSON. Two quick workarounds:
- have client add a longer read timeout + automatic retry on incomplete JSON parse
- or have runtime emit periodic keepalive bytes (whitespace/newline) so proxy doesn't mark connection idle.

kyle_sre: looking through proxy logs for rx-9f3b2a — I see an upstream reset at 15:04:49Z with `RST_STREAM` from their proxy to our edge. Our edge logged `upstream connection closed before response complete` and then cleaned up.

kyle_sre: can you ask the customer for a pcap or proxy logs around that exact time (15:04:45-15:05:00)? that'll confirm whether their proxy actively terminated due to idle or health checks.

ingrid_support: Customer says they can't produce PCAP due to policy. They did capture proxy syslog though — sending via secure share.

josh_support: uploaded their proxy syslog snippet: `conn 0x7fae2 idle-timeout 20s closed upstream`, multiple occurrences matching our request ids.

maria_eng: ok that strongly points at the idle-timeout behavior. For immediate mitigation I can push a small runtime change to emit 1-byte keepalive ("\n") at configurable intervals (default 15s) for streaming responses when using structured-json mode. This will keep the proxy connection active until we finish the final chunk.

eve_customer: would that require any client changes? we want to avoid parsing issues with keepalive bytes inserted.

maria_eng: good question — we'll ensure keepalive is sent as a separate SSE event or otherwise outside the JSON frame. Implementation plan: when stream mode is used with structured JSON, runtime will continue to send existing chunk boundaries and insert `: keepalive\n\n` (SSE comment) every 12s. That conforms to SSE and won't break JSON parsers consuming event-stream framing. We'll also ensure final flush sends a complete JSON object terminated with a newline and a final SSE event `event: done` so clients get a clean terminator.

kyle_sre: +1. Also ensure we never set Content-Length for streaming responses and that the connection termination code does a final write/flush attempt. Instrumentation: add a counter for `stream_final_write_failed` and backfill for the last 7 days for that route.

maria_eng: creating an internal ticket now.

deploy-bot: created issue RT-8423: "streaming: emit SSE keepalive + final done event to avoid proxy idle closes" assigned to maria_eng, priority P2.

maria_eng: quick repro for customers who can test locally (use socat to simulate proxy idle close):
```
# run our curl, but kill connection after 20s to mimic proxy
(sleep 20; pkill -f \"curl -N -H\") &
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate -d '{"stream":true,"input":"..."}'
```
If it truncates locally, confirms proxy-like behavior.

kyle_sre: I'll add logs to capture the last 256 bytes attempted to be written on stream close so we can see whether the runtime attempted the final chunk. That will tell us if it's purely proxy or also a server-side race.

ingrid_support: timeline for customer: can we have a patch in staging within 48h? customer is on a paid plan and it's impacting their production.

maria_eng: I can get a patch into a canary/branch within 24h. If tests pass then plan a staged rollout to hosted edge in 48-72h.

josh_support: told customer: patch coming, we'll provide a test build and ask them to confirm. Provided rx-9f3b2a as sample.

eve_customer: thanks, appreciate fast turnaround — we'll test the canary with our proxy rules and report back.

kyle_sre: action items: 1) maria to implement keepalive SSE + final done event (RT-8423) 2) kyle to add `stream_final_write_failed` instrumentation 3) ingrid to coordinate canary testing with AcmeCorp 4) support to collect any additional request-ids of failures.

maria_eng: noted. I'll update RT-8423 with implementation notes and a canary deployment plan. :thumbsup:

josh_support: closing loop with customer and will post results here when they test.
